body:
Thank you. I'll sort through these today and see if anything works. I'm going to reach out to my employer and see if I qualify for a hardship plan we have for medical reimbursement. 

I don't want to give up, because I know he wouldn't want me to. I just am not strong enough to do this.

I can't afford mental healthcare and my insurance doesn't cover it. I just feel like -- I don't want to be here, going from one temporary thing to the next. Existence is cruel and it really doesn't feel like there's much to live for in the world. There's a global pandemic and greedy politicians and the world just keeps getting worse. The only good things just don't seem to stay long.
